response.original_title: Travelocity Escalation Guide: How to Escalate Customer Service Issues, Booking Problems & Refunds
response.overview: To escalate an issue with Travelocity, call their customer support at+1-855-473-9012(US) (US) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) and explicitly ask the initial representative to transfer your call to a supervisor or the tier-two escalation desk Steps to Effectively Escalate Your Issue Prepare Documentation:+1-855-473-9012(US) (US) Have your itinerary number, booking confirmations, screenshots of error messages, and copies of previous chat or email transcripts ready before you call
response.title: Travelocity Escalation Guide: How to Escalate Customer Service Issues, Booking Problems & Refunds
